name: Adobe Creative Cloud Abonelik Şartları
text: Adobe Subscription Terms. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle unless cancelled, and a cancellation fee equal to 50% of the remaining contract obligation may apply upon early termination. We may share with certain trusted affiliates as long as necessary without specifying explicit retention periods.
